description: Read the weekly included Credit coverage, private Space usage rates and available features, with terms_url for the O++ website's terms page, plus whether the O++ assistant is available and its default request limit and finite response limits. A signed-in person's own coverage comes from account_get_usage. This tool has no plan, price or purchase details and terms_url covers usage terms only: if the person asks what a plan costs or how to get more Credits, say that is handled on the O++ website, outside this app.
name: product_get_policy
title: Read usage limits and the assistant's rules
